sentences.text: That, the Bilaspur Pathrapali Road Private Limited i.e. the Concessionaire wrote a letter dated 13.08.2025 to the answering respondent regarding prevention of stray cattle at Project Highway- Reg. wherein the former highlighter the all possible measures undertaken to mitigate the issue and also the reason as to why the issue remains unresolved.
The relevant extract of the letter is reproduced below as follows:
"However, despite these consistent and repeated efforts, the issue remains unresolved.
The primary reason for this is the non-availability of a permanent and authorized cattle confinement facility in the region.

It is important to emphasize that althou this issue does not fall within the contractual scope of the Concessionaire, we have continued to invest significant sources in addressing it, solely in the interest of public safety and uninterrupted highway operations.
Unfortunately, this has led to repeated financial losses due to ongoing operational expenses, which are neither contractually mandated nor technically our responsibility.

That, in view of the above, we earnestly request your kind intervention to initiate necessary coordination with the district authorities concerned or any other competent body to facilitate a long-term and effective resolution to this recurring issue.
Your support in this matter is crucial to ensure the safety of highway users and the preservation of highway infrastructure.
A detailed report outlining the actions taken by our team till date is enclosed herewith as Annexure-A for your kind perusal and necessary action."

Copy of the letter dated 13.08.2025 along with the detailed report outlining the actions taken by our team till date are collectively filed herewith as ANNEXURE E.
6.

That, the office of Zila Panchayat, Bilaspur, District Bilaspur, (C.G.) wrote a letter to the answering respondent requesting for grant of Rs. 5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakhs) for food and grains of the cattle shifted to the cow shelters in compliance of the order passed by this Hon'ble Court in WPPIL No. 58/2019 and WPPIL No. 63/2019.
The answering respondent deposited the said amount with the CEO, Zila Panchayat, Bilaspur and informed the same vide letter dated 02.08.2025.

Copy of the letters dated 02.08.2025 and 29.07.2025 are collectively filed herewith as ANNEXURE F.
7.

The action taken reports indicates that all the PIUs are jointly taking all the quintessential steps to reduce accidents and safeguard the lives of commuters on NH."

From perusal of the affidavit filed by the Project Director of the National Highway Authority of India (NHAI), it is reflected that several measures have been adopted to address the problem of stray cattle on the Simga-Sargaon-Bilaspur Section of NH-130/49 and Bilaspur Bypass Section of NH-49.
An additional RPV has been deployed and patrolling frequency enhanced.

sentences.text: Tenders have been floated for installation of bamboo fencing along 7.35 km stretch to prevent cattle entry.
Awareness measures such as distribution of leaflets at toll plazas, cautionary announcements through RPVs, VMS boards and installation of signboards have been undertaken.
Labourers have been deployed at identified spots for removal of cattle during day and night.
Reflective neck belts are being provided to cattle to ensure night visibility, and streetlights are being installed at critical points.

The Concessionaire, Bilaspur Pathrapali Road Pvt. Ltd., has apprised that despite continuous efforts, the issue persists owing to non-availability of a permanent and authorized cattle confinement facility, which is beyond the scope of the Concessionaire's contract.
The Zila Panchayat, Bilaspur, has also sought and been granted financial assistance of Rs.5,00,000/- for fodder of cattle kept in shelters pursuant to earlier orders of this Court.

Thus, it is evident that multiple remedial steps are being undertaken by the Regional Office, Raipur and concerned PIUs in coordination with State authorities to reduce accidents and safeguard highway users.

From the affidavit filed, it appears that the authorities have confined their remedial measures to NH-130/49 and the Bilaspur Bypass Section of NH-49, whereas no steps have been reported with respect to the part of NH-130 which passes through Ratanpur, namely the Bilaspur-Ambikapur National Highway.

In view thereof, the Project Director, National Highways Authority of India (NHAI), is directed to file a personal affidavit placing on record the measures undertaken with regard to the Bilaspur-Ambikapur stretch of NH-130 through Ratanpur.

The NHAI is further directed to take concrete steps for creating public awareness so that commuters are adequately cautioned while driving, and the public at large is sensitized through appropriate modes as may be deemed fit.
Such awareness shall ensure that no untoward incidents occur either to road users or to animals straying on the highway.
In compliance of the Court's order dated 31.07.2025, the District Magistrate, Bilaspur has also filed his personal affidavit, operative portion of which, reads as follows :

Further, cow- catchers are regularly operating on the road between Pendridih bypass and Nehru Chowk.

5. It is respectfully submitted that the shops of the Gram Panchayat Pendridih has been rented to provide employment to persons of village.
The shops are situated at a sufficient distance from the main road and shop owners have been instructed not to allow vehicles to be parked on the road creating any kind of hindrance in the traffic.
The Police Patrolling team has been directed to continuously survey the area and to keep it clean from any kind of traffic hindrance."
Perusal of the affidavit goes to show that the authorities, in compliance with the directions of this Court, have initiated several measures to regulate the situation at the Pendridih Bypass.
Encroachments in the area have been inspected and necessary directions have been issued for their removal, including prohibition of parking of vehicles beneath the bridge.
It has further been ensured that all streetlights in the area are in working condition and cow-catchers are regularly operating between Pendridih Bypass and Nehru Chowk.
The Municipal Corporation, Bilaspur, and Nagar Panchayat, Bodri, have deployed staff for continuous removal of stray cattle.

The affidavit also indicates that shops constructed by Gram Panchayat, Pendridih, have been allotted to villagers at a location away from the main road with strict instructions to prevent parking that may obstruct traffic.
In addition, the Police Patrolling Team has been directed to carry out regular surveillance so as to maintain free flow of traffic and to keep the area clear from any obstruction.

Mr. Yashwant Singh Thakur, learned Additional Advocate General, submits that the District Magistrate, Bilaspur, has inspected the Pendridih Bypass where traffic congestion was noticed and certain private persons had encroached upon Government land.
During the inspection, which he also attended along with various stakeholders, the encroachments were removed and some shops were sealed temporarily to facilitate alternative arrangements.

In view thereof, the District Magistrate, Bilaspur, is directed to file his personal affidavit by the next date of hearing, indicating the road-map prepared pursuant to this Court's order dated 31.07.2025.

It has been brought to the notice of this Court by Mr. Palash Tiwari that vide order dated 16.07.2025, this Court had directed the Chief Secretary of the State to file his personal affidavit with regard to the road accident which took place on the National Highway, wherein as many as seven cattles lost their lives.

The Court had further directed to clarify as to whether any person or authority has been held responsible for the lapses which resulted in such a horrific accident and to enquire who are the persons responsible and who have failed in discharge of their duties to prevent such incident.
However, till date, no affidavit has been filed by the Chief Secretary in compliance of the aforesaid order.
In view of the above, the Chief Secretary shall file his personal affidavit positively by the next date of hearing.

sentences.text: The Court has taken cognizance of the deteriorating condition of the Bilaspur-Ambikapur stretch of NH-130, particularly the portion passing through Ratanpur, which is stated to be one of the major causes of frequent accidents and inconvenience to the public at large.

In order to ascertain the role and responsibility of the local body in maintaining and regulating the said stretch, the Office is directed to implead Nagar Panchayat, Ratanpur, through its Chief Municipal Officer, as a party-respondent in the present proceedings.

Learned State counsel is directed to send a copy of this order to the Chief Municipal Officer, Nagar Panchayat, Ratanpur, who shall ensure necessary compliance by filing an appropriate response/affidavit before the next date of hearing.

Needless to observe that in the event any petition or litigation, having nexus with or pertaining to the subject matter involved in the present PIL, is instituted or comes up before this Court, the same shall not be heard separately in isolation.

The Registry is directed to ensure that such matters are, as far as practicable, placed before the same Bench and linked with the present PIL so that the issues arising therefrom are considered and adjudicated in a consolidated manner, thereby avoiding multiplicity of proceedings and the possibility of conflicting decisions.

Let these matters be listed again on 19th of September, 2025 for further monitoring of the matters.
 Sd/- Sd/-
 (Ravindra Kumar Agrawal) (Ramesh Sinha)
